notes.title: Craft In Abyss is officially launched
notes.content:
"Craft In Abyss" is a deep-sea tower defense Roguelike game. Players operate a deep-sea mobile fortress, where facilities such as forts and warehouses are built to defend against enemy attacks.

https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1200/1*eVlhUoyXWoO2VWWp0KMDIQ.jpeg

Blindly strengthening will be perishing?
Adding a fortress will make the fortress larger, making it cumbersome to operate and making it harder to avoid attacks. Excessively growing the fortress will lead to a dead end, so it is very important to manage the fortress in a planned way.

https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1200/1*y8_2NrCLB8DBOS6288Hj3w.jpeg

Incorporate lots of Roguelike elements
Different from traditional tower defense, players can only get random facilities and talents. Players have to think about how to play according to their ability to draw. You will enjoy a completely different game experience every time.

https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1200/1*B8x2b9gBw2oiBTOAoyVT4g.jpeg

Journey in search of sunshine
In the game, the player plays the heroine Alice, living in a huge urban tower inside the ocean, but yearning for the blue sky. Therefore, she got on the fortress, hoping to climb to the ground one day. In the process of climbing the tower, but discovered the amazing truth of the city?

https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1200/1*wQdj7ekwbLoae4gs41qKGA.png

During the Early Access for 4 months, the team has made a lot of optimizations on the game interface, screen special effects, hit feel, etc. The team hopes that this Public Release will reborn the Craft In Abyss.

Graphics：
https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1200/1*YUXdVcaM21r0i-Q_Ws0JCA.jpeg

notes.title: Craft In Abyss in Steam Game Festival
notes.content:
The Steam Game Festival Summer Edition started on June 16th, and the base-building rogue-lite game, Craft in Abys, joined with a free demo for everyone.

If you are interested, you can click the link below and download the demo right now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255050/Craft_In_Abyss/

Craft in Abyss is developed by Firepillar2, a Hong Kong indie studio. In the game, the player takes the role of the main female character, Alex. They will design their own fortress and embark on a journey, during which, they will learn new skills and gather resources to continuously strengthen their fortress.

Here’s the reveal trailer for the game:
[previewyoutube=CbPNTz6dpwQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is made up of 3 core gameplay mechanics - Facilities, Battle, and Skills.

Core Gameplay 1: Facilities

https://miro.medium.com/max/1104/1*JSQexWHVdhNkJV3YJZZU7w.gif

In order to build additional facilities on the fortress, the player will first have to construct a baseplate, which must be connected to the fortress itself. Do note that more baseplates aren’t always better, since additional baseplates increase the fortress’s size, making it easier for enemies to land their attacks as it will be more difficult to dodge the projectiles.

After designing the shape of the moving fortress, the player will then be able to build new facilities on them and set off to battle!

Core Gameplay 2: Battles

https://miro.medium.com/max/1104/1*7E2g2rRQs14hHer234ab7g.gif

During battles, the player will take control of the fortress, and utilize the rotating baseplates alongside the auto-defence facilities to defeat enemies. Defeated enemies will grant resources, which can be used to strengthen the fortress.

Core Gameplay 3: Skills

The player will be awarded digital totem found in the ruins after every battle. The player must make good use of the digital totems’ strengths in order to achieve victory.

An example of this would be a totem that provides “+75% Main Cannon damage. Main Cannon attacks now causes recoil.”. Such a skill would allow the main cannon to be used for dodging attacks as well as actually damaging enemies.

https://miro.medium.com/max/1280/1*u34iMmbU2Y3C2fmNniN_GA.gif

The most interesting part of this game is that the players will gain skills randomly, meaning that they won’t be able to actually permanently stick with a setup, and will have to adapt their playstyle according to the skills they receive, thereby providing them with a totally different experience every time they play the game.

Plot Synopsis

https://miro.medium.com/max/1104/1*ivCKPDKlshep0jOnXlYSvg.png

“Alex was born and raised in the Underwater Ruins, a sealed megastructure submerged deep beneath the ocean. As a genius engineer, she pilots her battleship alone in search for an exit at the top of the ruins in hopes of finding a solution to the threat of her home disappearing. Yet, what she came across was the mechanical assault from the labyrinth itself…:

The giant metropolis beneath the waves, the cowardly civilians and the ignorant upper class in Craft in Abyss mirror the downfall of Hong Kong (and other modern cities), and highlights the importance of facing history head-on. Meanwhile, the sacrifice and perseverance of the characters within the plot symbolize the hard work of the selfless people that try to save their home.

Craft in Abyss is a part of the Steam Game Festival Summer Edition, if you are interested, you can click the link below and download the demo right now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255050/Craft_In_Abyss/

notes.title: First Major Update
notes.content:
During the end of may, we finally released a demo for our upcoming game on Steam - Craft in Abyss. Now, after two weeks or so later, we'll be bringing you the first major update.

1. Visual Renderings
https://miro.medium.com/max/540/1*ELVII0R_dRXI-FNHghDhmg.gif

We put a bit of a twist on the visual effects, so that it would give off a feeling of refraction underwater. What's more, we also tried to use more realistic lighting and coloring. Additionally, since it's harder to see underwater, and we're worried that our original choice of coloring would cause visual clarity issues, we swapped our palette around a little, while it may seem less like it is underwater, we believe that clarify should still be prioritized. Hopefully, you guys are now able to see every little detail on your screens now.

2. Game Pacing
 https://miro.medium.com/max/540/1*NI0XVuFW1v888XjFXqKlUQ.gif

Actions are now automatically used whenever they are off cooldown. Players will no longer have to click on each action to use them.
From the feedback we've received, it seems like the base-building fans out there weren't really looking for tense fights that required them to concentrate too much on the battle.

3. Interface
 https://miro.medium.com/max/540/1*qoij_oURK-txj8AqPqrG0g.gif

Motion UI design is often found in games nowadays, but that's something we don't have... yet. We'll continue on work on it and improve the UI's fluidity.
 
https://miro.medium.com/max/540/1*xYZfThBx9UdscdAYnamusQ.gif

We added a drag and drop system to the interface as you can see above. The new component creation process will be utilizing this new interface. The special properties and effects that the different materials have are also clearly visible at the bottom, so hopefully, it'll help players understand what kind of component will be synthesized.
 
https://miro.medium.com/max/540/1*s3W_ZA02pqDonKxGLHd3cg.gif

We also implemented symbols for the some of the stages to show the special ones. In the gif above, it is a Wreckage Stage, where players will be able to salvage a wreckage in order to obtain resources. Some of the other special stages are Shop stages, Laboratory stages etc.

4. Tutorial
 https://miro.medium.com/max/540/1*6L7wlGXXPMQpmlf_ARiiTQ.gif

We added a lot of "I" symbols in the new patch. You can now hover over them in order to understand what the current interface you are on is for.

Please add Craft in Abyss to your wish list!
If you guys do like and recognize our hard work and efforts, please do try out the new patch and add the game to your wish list. Your support is extremely important to us!.
